findings.title: Removed module-level helpers break existing imports
findings.body: This refactor removes the `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and `SimpleCheckIn` names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` without forwarding aliases.
